name: Example: Match Patterns
author: byo-pop examples
description: Other ways to match: runs of another length, diagonal runs, crossing runs of one colour that score as an L, T or plus, and 2 x 2 squares. Each pattern can earn bonus points. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Shortest run
settings.help: Gems in a row that make a match. The original: 3.

settings.label: Diagonal runs
settings.help: Runs along both diagonals match too.

settings.label: Diagonal bonus
settings.help: Points added for a diagonal run, before the level's multiplier.

settings.label: Crossing runs join
settings.help: Runs of one colour that cross form one group, an L, T or plus.

settings.label: L and T bonus
settings.help: Points added for an L or a T, before the multiplier.

settings.label: Plus bonus
settings.help: Points added for a plus, before the multiplier.

settings.label: 2 x 2 squares
settings.help: Four gems of one colour in a square match too.

settings.label: Square bonus
settings.help: Points added for a square, before the multiplier.
